title: Rewst case handoff
use_case: Hand each new or changed case to a Rewst workflow, which then tickets, documents or notifies across the MSP's PSA, RMM and documentation tools.
trigger: Platform Events, source Case, events Create, Update and Comment Added. Leave When does this playbook run? at Always; the playbook's own settings do the scoping. It can also run by hand from a case.
connections: Taegis.Webhook 1.1.4, the Generic Webhook connector Sophos manages, set to your Rewst webhook trigger URL, with the x-rewst-secret header as the API key if the trigger has a secret
Taegis.Case 1.0.5, the case connector Sophos manages, to read the case
requires: A Rewst organization with a workflow that starts from a webhook trigger, and Sophos Fusion playbooks under Security Operations > Automations
mdr_note: Sophos MDR doesn't run or watch this playbook, and it doesn't change what Sophos MDR does. What your Rewst workflow does with the case is up to that workflow: keep anything that acts on hosts or accounts out of it unless your MDR contact knows.
rollback: None for what was sent. Turn the playbook off to stop sending.
author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Not run against Rewst: there was no Rewst organization to test with. On 2026-10-21 a renamed copy passed playbookValidateDSLV2 with no errors or warnings in a Sophos Fusion tenant, imported, exported again unchanged apart from the tenant's own fields, and was deleted. The document it sends is fixed: see What leaves Sophos Fusion in the template documentation.
